name: Runtime-budget pilot (32 calls, 8 vs 7 minutes)
design: paired runtime-engineering screening pilot on an 8-task stress panel
design_note: Only the per-task time cap differs between arms. Not a gate for any external evaluation and not an estimate of the overall solve rate.

runs.label: pilot
runs.frozen_utc_note: re-freeze after Amendment 1 (pre-data; made after launch, before any output was retrieved or seen)
runs.completed_utc_basis: first status check that showed the run complete (the previous check, 12:01:33Z, showed it running)
registered_outcomes: INSUFFICIENT (PARTIAL run with fewer than 6 complete pairs)

amendments.summary: time cap reached also counts an agent active span of at least the cap minus 3 s (silent time cap); can only make the rule stricter against 32/7

panel.description: stress panel drawn from the 48-task development panel by a deterministic rule on E8 traces: G1 = 3 E8 treatment-only solves, G2 = 2 E8 solves with the last source edit after 420 s, G3 = 3 highest stress-score tasks

known_caveat: the system prompt is unchanged and still states 28 tool calls and 8 minutes in both arms
